integrity: Deterministic all-order proof and random limiting proof are written explicitly. A separate direct-distance implementation agrees with the criterion in all 2130944 small ground-graph cases and 150000 sampled cases; these finite tests are not proofs. No external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact criterion applies to KG(n,2), n at least five. The random limit applies to independent uniformly sampled Kneser vertices. It makes no claim about larger Kneser uniformity, arbitrary correlations, or distributions outside the specified critical window. Full bibliographic priority and independent validation have not been established.
title: Component obstructions and the sharp random resolving window of two-subset Kneser graphs
